limitations: The 2020 all-candidate field had 15 candidates; the 2026 Senate general has two after a new closed-party-primary system. This is a major structural confound for party and race-count changes.
Exploratory party/race/population screens cannot attribute a change to a cause or establish wrongdoing, fraud, error, an audit finding or comparable candidate availability.

This contract is only the regular Class II Senate first November ballot in 2020 and 2026, preserving first round/sourceStage general for 2020 and general for 2026. It does not qualify House elections or change the global stage guard.
All 960 prior cells match the pinned upstream research release and all 15 column sums match independent FEC controls. This aggregate reconciliation is not an independent parish/voter audit.

Current 128 cells reconcile county/state within one existing official-attributed registered extract. No new direct primary count-vector endorsement is claimed. Source timestamp unavailable; fetch time remains labeled as fetch time.
Existing truncated names Bill Cassi and Xan Jo remain unchanged; FEC aliases document controls only. Minor parties, no-party-affiliation and independents remain Other; no reassignment.
The 2020 presidential-cycle versus 2026 midterm, provisional current counts, population estimates and changed rules further limit interpretation. Race vote sums are not ballots or unique turnout.
No new zeros, no null conversions, no winner promotion, and no claim that all reported precincts means certified/final.
The county/parish inventory is unchanged. No new legal boundary survey was performed. Any pinned source or vector/stage/quality/date change requires renewed qualification.
